details: The U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) for April rose to 6.0% year-over-year, exceeding market expectations of 4.9%. This hotter-than-expected inflation data suggests persistent inflationary pressures, which could influence the Federal Reserve's monetary policy decisions.
title: US April PPI Higher Than Expected, Fueling Inflation Concerns

details: The U.S. Senate has approved Kevin Warsh as the next Federal Reserve Chair. His appointment concludes a period of uncertainty regarding central bank leadership, with markets closely watching his future statements for cues on monetary policy direction and potential interest rate adjustments.
title: Kevin Warsh Approved as New Federal Reserve Chair

details: The U.S. Senate Banking Committee is scheduled to hold a critical vote on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act). A compromise on stablecoin yield provisions has been reached, aiming to establish a clearer regulatory framework for the U.S. crypto market.
title: Senate Banking Committee to Vote on CLARITY Act

details: Financial services giant Charles Schwab has started rolling out direct spot crypto trading services within its brokerage platform. This initiative will provide clients with exposure to Bitcoin and Ethereum, significantly expanding access to digital assets within mainstream investment channels.
title: Charles Schwab Begins Offering Spot Crypto Trading

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has issued a warning regarding rising oil prices and the increasing likelihood of a global recession. This macroeconomic uncertainty is creating turbulence in financial markets, prompting some crypto investors to seek out potential opportunities within the volatile digital asset landscape.
title: IMF Warns of Recession Amid Soaring Oil Prices
